import headers = "./headers.qui"

class Mailbox(string name, string address)
class Address(bool group, Mailbox[] mailboxes)
class Parsed(Address[] addresses, bool encoding_error)

bool dot_atom(headers.Token[] tokens)
    if #tokens == 0 or #tokens % 2 == 0
        return false
    for: position < int(#tokens)
        expected := if position % 2 == 0 then "word" else "."
        if tokens[position].kind != expected
            return false
    return true

string | none address_string(headers.Token[] local_part, headers.Token[] domain)
    if not dot_atom(local_part) or not dot_atom(domain)
        return none
    left := [for token := local_part[] then token.text].join("")
    right := [for token := domain[] then token.text].join("")
    return headers.lowercase(left + "@" + right)

class Parser(headers.Token[] tokens)
    position := 0
    encoding_error := false

    string peek_kind()
        return if position < int(#tokens) then tokens[position].kind else ""

    bool .expect(string kind)
        if peek_kind() != kind
            return false
        position += 1
        return true

    headers.Token[] .read_run(string[] kinds)
        start := position
        while headers.one_of(peek_kind(), kinds)
            position += 1
        return tokens[start:<position]

    string .display_name(headers.Token[] phrase)
        result := ""
        previous_decoded := false
        for: index < int(#phrase)
            token := phrase[index]
            text := token.text
            decoded := false
            if token.kind == "word"
                word := headers.decode_word(token.text)
                text = word.text
                decoded = word.decoded
                encoding_error = encoding_error or word.failed
            if index > 0 and token.spaced and not (decoded and previous_decoded)
                result += " "
            result += text
            previous_decoded = decoded
        return headers.collapse_whitespace(result)

    Address | none .parse_address(bool in_group)
        headers.Token[] phrase := .read_run(["word", "quoted", "."])
        string following := peek_kind()
        if following == "<"
            position += 1
            headers.Token[] local_part := .read_run(["word", "."])
            if not .expect("@")
                return none
            headers.Token[] domain := .read_run(["word", "."])
            if not .expect(">")
                return none
            match address_string(local_part, domain)
                string address
                    return Address(false, [Mailbox(.display_name(phrase), address)])
                none
                    return none
        if following == "@"
            position += 1
            headers.Token[] domain := .read_run(["word", "."])
            match address_string(phrase, domain)
                string address
                    return Address(false, [Mailbox("", address)])
                none
                    return none
        if following == ":" and #phrase > 0 and not in_group
            position += 1
            Mailbox[] members := []
            if peek_kind() != ";"
                while true
                    match .parse_address(true)
                        Address parsed
                            if parsed.group
                                return none
                            members = members.concat(parsed.mailboxes)
                        none
                            return none
                    if peek_kind() != ","
                        break
                    position += 1
            if not .expect(";")
                return none
            return Address(true, members)
        return none

    Parsed | none .parse_list()
        Address[] result := []
        while true
            match .parse_address(false)
                Address parsed
                    result = result.append(parsed)
                none
                    return none
            if peek_kind() != ","
                break
            position += 1
        if position != int(#tokens)
            return none
        return Parsed(result, encoding_error)

Parsed | none parse_address_list(string value)
    headers.Token[] tokens := []
    match headers.tokenize(value, true)
        headers.Token[] parsed
            tokens = parsed
        none
            return none
    if #tokens == 0
        return none
    parser := Parser(tokens)
    return .parser.parse_list()

import headers = "./headers.qui"

bool is_leap(int year)
    return (year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 != 0) or year % 400 == 0

int days_in_month(int year, int month)
    lengths := [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
    return if month == 2 and is_leap(year) then 29 else lengths[month - 1]

int days_in_year(int year)
    return if is_leap(year) then 366 else 365

int days_since_epoch(int year, int month, int day)
    total := day - 1
    for: 1970 <= current < year
        total += days_in_year(current)
    for: 1 <= current < month
        total += days_in_month(year, current)
    return total

string format_utc(int seconds)
    days := seconds / 86400
    remainder := seconds % 86400
    year := 1970
    while days >= days_in_year(year)
        days -= days_in_year(year)
        year += 1
    month := 1
    while days >= days_in_month(year, month)
        days -= days_in_month(year, month)
        month += 1
    day := days + 1
    hour := remainder / 3600
    minute := (remainder % 3600) / 60
    second := remainder % 60
    return "{year:04.}-{month:02.}-{day:02.} {hour:02.}:{minute:02.}:{second:02.}"

bool has_digits(string text, int low, int high)
    if not (low <= int(#text) <= high)
        return false
    for code := text.codepoints()[]
        if not (48 <= code <= 57)
            return false
    return true

int position_of(string value, string[] names)
    for: position < int(#names)
        if value == names[position]
            return position
    return -1

int | error parse_date(string value)
    stripped := ""
    match headers.remove_comments(value)
        string text
            stripped = text
        none
            return error("bad Date syntax")
    tokens := headers.split_words(stripped.split(",").join(" , "))
    weekdays := ["mon", "tue", "wed", "thu", "fri", "sat", "sun"]
    months := ["jan", "feb", "mar", "apr", "may", "jun", "jul", "aug", "sep", "oct", "nov", "dec"]
    weekday := -1
    if #tokens >= 3 and tokens[1] == ","
        weekday = position_of(headers.lowercase(tokens[0]), weekdays)
        if weekday >= 0
            tokens = tokens[2:<#tokens]
    if #tokens != 5
        return error("bad Date syntax")
    pieces := tokens[3].split(":")
    month := position_of(headers.lowercase(tokens[1]), months) + 1
    valid_year := has_digits(tokens[2], 2, 2) or has_digits(tokens[2], 4, 4)
    valid_time := #pieces == 2 or #pieces == 3
    for piece := pieces[]
        valid_time = valid_time and has_digits(piece, 2, 2)
    zone := headers.lowercase(tokens[4])
    zone_names := ["ut", "gmt", "z", "est", "edt", "cst", "cdt", "mst", "mdt", "pst", "pdt"]
    zone_offsets := [0, 0, 0, -300, -240, -360, -300, -420, -360, -480, -420]
    numeric_zone := #zone == 5 and (zone[0] == "+" or zone[0] == "-") and has_digits(zone[1:<#zone], 4, 4)
    named_zone := position_of(zone, zone_names)
    if not has_digits(tokens[0], 1, 2) or month == 0 or not valid_year or not valid_time or (not numeric_zone and named_zone < 0)
        return error("bad Date syntax")
    day := int(tokens[0])
    year := int(tokens[2])
    if #tokens[2] == 2
        year += if year < 50 then 2000 else 1900
    hour := int(pieces[0])
    minute := int(pieces[1])
    int second := if #pieces == 3 then int(pieces[2]) else 0
    offset := 0
    if numeric_zone
        zone_hour := int(zone[1:<3])
        zone_minute := int(zone[3:<5])
        if zone_hour > 23 or zone_minute > 59
            return error("Date out of range")
        offset = zone_hour * 60 + zone_minute
        if zone[0] == "-"
            offset = -offset
    else
        offset = zone_offsets[named_zone]
    if year < 1970 or year > 2099 or day < 1 or day > days_in_month(year, month) or hour > 23 or minute > 59 or second > 59
        return error("Date out of range")
    days := days_since_epoch(year, month, day)
    seconds := days * 86400 + hour * 3600 + minute * 60 + second - offset * 60
    if seconds < 0
        return error("Date out of range")
    if weekday >= 0 and (days + 3) % 7 != weekday
        return error("Date weekday mismatch")
    return seconds

import mime = "./mime.qui"

string lowercase(string text)
    nat8[] bytes := nat8[](text.utf8())
    for &code := &bytes[]
        if 65 <= code <= 90
            code += 32
    string result := string.from_utf8(bin(bytes))
    return result

string[] split_words(string text)
    return [for word := text.split(HT).join(" ").split(" ")[] if word != "" then word]

string collapse_whitespace(string text)
    return split_words(text).join(" ")

int find_from(string text, string needle, start := 0)
    match text[start:<#text].find(needle)
        nat position
            return start + int(position)
        none
            return -1

bool one_of(string value, string[] choices)
    for choice := choices[]
        if value == choice
            return true
    return false

class Line(int number, string text)
class Field(string name, string value)

class Header(local Line[] source_lines)
    Field[] fields := []
    int[] invalid_lines := []
    local in_field := false
    for line := source_lines[]
        if line.text[0] == " " or line.text[0] == HT
            if in_field
                fields[-1].value += line.text
            else
                invalid_lines = invalid_lines.append(line.number)
            continue
        local colon := find_from(line.text, ":")
        in_field = colon > 0
        if in_field
            for code := line.text[0:<colon].codepoints()[]
                if not (33 <= code <= 126)
                    in_field = false
                    break
        if in_field
            fields = fields.append(Field(lowercase(line.text[0:<colon]), line.text[colon + 1:<#line.text]))
        else
            invalid_lines = invalid_lines.append(line.number)
    for: position < int(#fields)
        fields[position].value = fields[position].value.trim()

    int count(string name)
        result := 0
        wanted := lowercase(name)
        for field := fields[]
            if field.name == wanted
                result += 1
        return result

    string get(string name, fallback := "")
        wanted := lowercase(name)
        for field := fields[]
            if field.name == wanted
                return field.value
        return fallback

string | none remove_comments(string text)
    result := ""
    depth := 0
    escaped := false
    for: position < int(#text)
        symbol := text[position]
        if depth == 0
            if symbol == "("
                depth = 1
                result += " "
            else
                result += symbol
        elif escaped
            escaped = false
        elif symbol.codepoints()[0] == 92
            escaped = true
        elif symbol == "("
            depth += 1
        elif symbol == ")"
            depth -= 1
    return if depth == 0 then result else none

int | none skip_comment(string text, int start)
    depth := 0
    position := start
    while position < int(#text)
        symbol := text[position]
        if symbol.codepoints()[0] == 92
            position += 2
            continue
        if symbol == "("
            depth += 1
        elif symbol == ")"
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0
                return position + 1
        position += 1
    return none

class Quoted(string text, int end)

Quoted | none read_quoted(string text, int start)
    result := ""
    position := start + 1
    while position < int(#text)
        symbol := text[position]
        if symbol == DQ
            return Quoted(result, position + 1)
        if symbol.codepoints()[0] == 92
            position += 1
            if position == int(#text)
                return none
            symbol = text[position]
        result += symbol
        position += 1
    return none

bool word_character(string symbol, bool for_address)
    int code := symbol.codepoints()[0]
    if for_address
        return (65 <= code <= 90) or (97 <= code <= 122) or (48 <= code <= 57) or "!#$%&'*+-/=?^_`{{|}}~".contains(symbol)
    string excluded := "()<>@,;:/[]?=" + DQ
    return 33 <= code <= 126 and code != 92 and not excluded.contains(symbol)

class Token(string kind, string text, bool spaced)

Token[] | none tokenize(string text, bool for_address)
    Token[] tokens := []
    specials := if for_address then "<>:;@,." else "/;="
    spaced := false
    position := 0
    while position < int(#text)
        symbol := text[position]
        if symbol == " " or symbol == HT
            spaced = true
            position += 1
            continue
        if symbol == "("
            match skip_comment(text, position)
                int end
                    position = end
                none
                    return none
            spaced = true
            continue
        if symbol == DQ
            match read_quoted(text, position)
                Quoted quoted
                    tokens = tokens.append(Token("quoted", quoted.text, spaced))
                    position = quoted.end
                none
                    return none
        elif specials.contains(symbol)
            tokens = tokens.append(Token(symbol, symbol, spaced))
            position += 1
        elif word_character(symbol, for_address)
            end := position + 1
            while end < int(#text) and word_character(text[end], for_address)
                end += 1
            tokens = tokens.append(Token("word", text[position:<end], spaced))
            position = end
        else
            return none
        spaced = false
    return tokens

nat8[] | none decode_q(string text)
    nat8[] result := []
    position := 0
    while position < int(#text)
        if text[position] == "_"
            result = result.append(32)
            position += 1
        elif text[position] == "="
            if position + 2 >= int(#text)
                return none
            high := mime.hex_value(text[position + 1])
            low := mime.hex_value(text[position + 2])
            if high < 0 or low < 0
                return none
            result = result.append(nat8(16 * high + low))
            position += 3
        else
            result = result.append(nat8(text[position].codepoints()[0]))
            position += 1
    return result

class WordDecoded(string text, bool decoded, bool failed)

WordDecoded decode_word(string word)
    if #word < 4 or not word.starts_with("=?") or not word.ends_with("?=")
        return WordDecoded(word, false, false)
    pieces := word[2:<#word - 2].split("?")
    if #pieces != 3
        return WordDecoded(word, false, false)
    for piece := pieces[]
        if piece == ""
            return WordDecoded(word, false, false)
    if lowercase(pieces[0]) != "us-ascii" or not one_of(pieces[1], ["Q", "q", "B", "b"])
        return WordDecoded(word, false, true)
    nat8[] | none raw := if pieces[1] == "Q" or pieces[1] == "q" then decode_q(pieces[2]) else mime.strict_base64(pieces[2])
    nat8[] bytes := []
    match raw
        nat8[] decoded
            bytes = decoded
        none
            return WordDecoded(word, false, true)
    for code := bytes[]
        if not (32 <= code <= 126)
            return WordDecoded(word, false, true)
    string result := string.from_utf8(bin(bytes))
    return WordDecoded(result, true, false)

class TextDecoded(string text, bool failed)

TextDecoded decode_unstructured(string value)
    result := ""
    failed := false
    previous_decoded := false
    first := true
    for word := split_words(value)[]
        decoded := decode_word(word)
        if not first and not (decoded.decoded and previous_decoded)
            result += " "
        result += decoded.text
        failed = failed or decoded.failed
        previous_decoded = decoded.decoded
        first = false
    return TextDecoded(collapse_whitespace(result), failed)

class Parameters(string main_type, string subtype, map<string, string> values)
    string get(string name)
        match values.get(name)
            string value
                return value
            none
                return ""

Parameters | none parse_parameters(string value, bool with_subtype)
    Token[] tokens := []
    match tokenize(value, false)
        Token[] parsed
            tokens = parsed
        none
            return none
    if #tokens == 0 or tokens[0].kind != "word"
        return none
    main_type := lowercase(tokens[0].text)
    subtype := ""
    position := 1
    if with_subtype
        if #tokens < 3 or tokens[1].kind != "/" or tokens[2].kind != "word"
            return none
        subtype = lowercase(tokens[2].text)
        position = 3
    map<string, string> parameters
    while position < int(#tokens)
        if position + 3 >= int(#tokens)
            return none
        if tokens[position].kind != ";" or tokens[position + 1].kind != "word" or tokens[position + 2].kind != "=" or not one_of(tokens[position + 3].kind, ["word", "quoted"])
            return none
        name := lowercase(tokens[position + 1].text)
        if not parameters.has(name)
            .parameters.set(name, tokens[position + 3].text)
        position += 4
    return Parameters(main_type, subtype, parameters)

import math
import headers = "./headers.qui"
import addresses = "./addresses.qui"
import mime = "./mime.qui"
import dates = "./dates.qui"
import threader = "./threader.qui"

string[] read_lines(string path)
    text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    string[] lines := text.split(NL)
    return lines[0:<#lines - 1]

headers.Line[][] read_mailbox()
    headers.Line[][] messages := []
    lines := read_lines("input/mailbox.mbox")
    for: position < int(#lines)
        text := lines[position]
        if text.starts_with("From ")
            messages = messages.append([])
        else
            prefix := 0
            while prefix < int(#text) and text[prefix] == ">"
                prefix += 1
            if prefix > 0 and text[prefix:<#text].starts_with("From ")
                text = text[1:<#text]
            last := int(#messages) - 1
            messages[last] = messages[last].append(headers.Line(position + 1, text))
    for: position < int(#messages)
        count := int(#messages[position])
        if count > 0 and messages[position][count - 1].text == ""
            messages[position] = messages[position][0:<count - 1]
    return messages

class Sections(headers.Line[] header, headers.Line[] body)

Sections split_sections(headers.Line[] lines)
    for: position < int(#lines)
        if lines[position].text == ""
            return Sections(lines[0:<position], lines[position + 1:<#lines])
    return Sections(lines, [])

bool is_message_id(string text)
    if #text < 3 or not text.starts_with("<") or not text.ends_with(">")
        return false
    inside := text[1:<#text - 1]
    if #inside.split("@") != 2 or inside.starts_with("@") or inside.ends_with("@")
        return false
    for code := inside.codepoints()[]
        if not (33 <= code <= 126) or code == 92 or code == 34 or "<>()".contains(mime.character(code))
            return false
    return true

string[] extract_ids(string value)
    string[] result := []
    start := headers.find_from(value, "<")
    while start >= 0
        end := headers.find_from(value, ">", start + 1)
        if end < 0
            break
        candidate := value[start:<end + 1]
        if is_message_id(candidate)
            result = result.append(candidate)
        start = headers.find_from(value, "<", end + 1)
    return result

string subject_notation(string text)
    return if text == "" then "(no subject)" else text

string date_notation(int | none timestamp)
    match timestamp
        int seconds
            return dates.format_utc(seconds)
        none
            return "invalid"

class Entity(string number)
    main_type := "text"
    subtype := "plain"
    parameters := map<string, string>()
    disposition := ""
    filename := ""
    multipart := false
    int[] children := []
    content := ""

    string parameter(string name)
        match parameters.get(name)
            string value
                return value
            none
                return ""

class Message(int number, local headers.Line[] initial_lines, local map<string, int> &initial_ids)
    string[] problems := []
    addresses.Mailbox | none sender := none
    string[] to := []
    string[] cc := []
    subject := ""
    base_subject := ""
    reply := false
    int | none timestamp := none
    id := ""
    string[] references := []
    Entity[] entities := []
    root := -1
    thread := 0
    depth := 0
    parent_message := -1
    .parse_message(initial_lines, &initial_ids)

    void .problem(string text)
        problems = problems.append(text)

    void .parse_message(headers.Line[] lines, map<string, int> &known_ids)
        sections := split_sections(lines)
        header := headers.Header(sections.header)
        for line_number := header.invalid_lines[]
            .problem("bad header line {line_number}")
        checked := ["From", "To", "Cc", "Subject", "Date", "Message-ID", "In-Reply-To", "References", "MIME-Version", "Content-Type", "Content-Transfer-Encoding", "Content-Disposition"]
        for name := checked[]
            if header.count(name) > 1
                .problem("duplicate " + name)
        .read_sender(header)
        to = .read_recipients(header, "To")
        cc = .read_recipients(header, "Cc")
        decoded := headers.decode_unstructured(header.get("Subject"))
        subject = decoded.text
        if decoded.failed
            .problem("bad encoded word in Subject")
        base_subject = subject
        while #base_subject >= 3 and headers.lowercase(base_subject[0:<3]) == "re:"
            base_subject = base_subject[3:<#base_subject]
            while base_subject.starts_with(" ")
                base_subject = base_subject[1:<#base_subject]
            reply = true
        if header.count("Date") == 0
            .problem("missing Date")
        else
            match dates.parse_date(header.get("Date"))
                int seconds
                    timestamp = seconds
                error failure
                    .problem(failure.message)
        if header.count("Message-ID") == 0
            .problem("missing Message-ID")
        else
            candidate := header.get("Message-ID")
            if not is_message_id(candidate)
                .problem("bad Message-ID")
            else
                match known_ids.get(candidate)
                    int first
                        .problem("Message-ID already used by message {first}")
                    none
                        id = candidate
                        .known_ids.set(candidate, number)
        references = extract_ids(header.get("References"))
        replies := extract_ids(header.get("In-Reply-To"))
        if #replies > 0 and (#references == 0 or references[-1] != replies[0])
            references = references.append(replies[0])
        enabled := false
        if header.count("MIME-Version") > 0
            match headers.remove_comments(header.get("MIME-Version"))
                string text
                    enabled = headers.split_words(text).join("") == "1.0"
                none
                    void
            if not enabled
                .problem("bad MIME-Version")
        root = .parse_entity("1", header, sections.body, enabled)

    void .read_sender(headers.Header header)
        if header.count("From") == 0
            .problem("missing From")
            return
        match addresses.parse_address_list(header.get("From"))
            addresses.Parsed parsed
                if #parsed.addresses != 1 or parsed.addresses[0].group
                    .problem("bad From")
                else
                    sender = parsed.addresses[0].mailboxes[0]
                    if parsed.encoding_error
                        .problem("bad encoded word in From")
            none
                .problem("bad From")

    string[] .read_recipients(headers.Header header, string name)
        string[] recipients := []
        if header.count(name) == 0
            return recipients
        match addresses.parse_address_list(header.get(name))
            addresses.Parsed parsed
                for entry := parsed.addresses[]
                    for mailbox := entry.mailboxes[]
                        recipients = recipients.append(mailbox.address)
                if parsed.encoding_error
                    .problem("bad encoded word in " + name)
            none
                .problem("bad " + name)
        return recipients

    int .parse_entity(string part_number, headers.Header header, headers.Line[] lines, bool enabled)
        index := int(#entities)
        entities = entities.append(Entity(part_number))
        if enabled and header.count("Content-Type") > 0
            match headers.parse_parameters(header.get("Content-Type"), true)
                headers.Parameters parsed
                    entities[index].main_type = parsed.main_type
                    entities[index].subtype = parsed.subtype
                    entities[index].parameters = parsed.values
                none
                    .problem("bad Content-Type in part {part_number}")
        if enabled and header.count("Content-Disposition") > 0
            match headers.parse_parameters(header.get("Content-Disposition"), false)
                headers.Parameters parsed
                    entities[index].disposition = parsed.main_type
                    entities[index].filename = parsed.get("filename")
                none
                    .problem("bad Content-Disposition in part {part_number}")
        if entities[index].filename == ""
            entities[index].filename = entities[index].parameter("name")
        if entities[index].main_type == "text" and entities[index].parameters.has("charset")
            charset := headers.lowercase(entities[index].parameter("charset"))
            if charset != "us-ascii"
                .problem("unsupported charset {DQ}{charset}{DQ} in part {part_number}")
        if enabled and entities[index].main_type == "multipart"
            boundary := entities[index].parameter("boundary")
            if boundary != ""
                .split_multipart(index, lines, boundary)
                return index
            .problem("missing boundary in part {part_number}")
        original := [for line := lines[] then line.text].join(NL)
        encoding := if enabled and header.count("Content-Transfer-Encoding") > 0 then headers.lowercase(header.get("Content-Transfer-Encoding")) else "7bit"
        if encoding == "base64"
            match mime.decode_base64_body(original)
                string text
                    entities[index].content = text
                none
                    .problem("bad base64 in part {part_number}")
        elif encoding == "quoted-printable"
            decoded := mime.decode_quoted_printable(original)
            entities[index].content = decoded.text
            if decoded.failed
                .problem("bad quoted-printable in part {part_number}")
        else
            entities[index].content = original
            if not headers.one_of(encoding, ["7bit", "8bit", "binary"])
                .problem("unknown encoding {DQ}{encoding}{DQ} in part {part_number}")
        return index

    void .split_multipart(int index, headers.Line[] lines, string boundary)
        headers.Line[][] parts := []
        closed := false
        for line := lines[]
            text := mime.trim_trailing(line.text)
            if text == "--" + boundary + "--"
                closed = true
                break
            if text == "--" + boundary
                parts = parts.append([])
            elif #parts > 0
                last := int(#parts) - 1
                parts[last] = parts[last].append(line)
        if #parts == 0
            .problem("no parts in part {entities[index].number}")
        elif not closed
            .problem("unterminated multipart in part {entities[index].number}")
        entities[index].multipart = true
        for: position < int(#parts)
            sections := split_sections(parts[position])
            header := headers.Header(sections.header)
            for line_number := header.invalid_lines[]
                .problem("bad header line {line_number}")
            part_number := "{entities[index].number}.{position + 1}"
            int child := .parse_entity(part_number, header, sections.body, true)
            entities[index].children = entities[index].children.append(child)

    threader.MessageInfo info()
        dated := false
        seconds := 0
        match timestamp
            int value
                dated = true
                seconds = value
            none
                void
        return threader.MessageInfo(number, dated, seconds, id, references, base_subject, reply)

int[] collect_text_parts(Entity[] entities, int index, bool allow_html)
    entity := entities[index]
    if not entity.multipart
        if entity.disposition == "attachment" or entity.main_type != "text"
            return []
        return if entity.subtype == "plain" or (entity.subtype == "html" and allow_html) then [index] else []
    if entity.subtype == "alternative"
        for html_pass := [false, true][]
            for child := entity.children[]
                found := collect_text_parts(entities, child, html_pass)
                if #found > 0
                    return found
        return []
    int[] result := []
    for child := entity.children[]
        result = result.concat(collect_text_parts(entities, child, allow_html))
    return result

string quote_prefix(int depth)
    return if depth == 0 then "" else ">" * nat(depth) + " "

string[] wrap(string text, string prefix)
    string[] lines := []
    current := ""
    for word := headers.split_words(text)[]
        if current != "" and #current + 1 + #word > 72
            lines = lines.append(current)
            current = word
        elif current == ""
            current = word
        else
            current += " " + word
    lines = lines.append(current)
    return [for line := lines[] then prefix + line]

class LogicalLine(int depth, string text, flowing := false)

string[] flowed_lines(string content, bool delete_space)
    if content == ""
        return []
    LogicalLine[] logical := []
    for line := content.split(NL)[]
        depth := 0
        while depth < int(#line) and line[depth] == ">"
            depth += 1
        text := line[depth:<#line]
        if text.starts_with(" ")
            text = text[1:<#text]
        flowing := text.ends_with(" ") and text != "-- "
        last := int(#logical) - 1
        if last >= 0 and logical[last].flowing and logical[last].depth == depth
            if delete_space
                logical[last].text = logical[last].text[0:<#logical[last].text - 1]
            logical[last].text += text
            logical[last].flowing = flowing
        else
            logical = logical.append(LogicalLine(depth, text, flowing))
    string[] result := []
    for line := logical[]
        result = result.concat(wrap(line.text, quote_prefix(line.depth)))
    return result

string | none reference_value(string name)
    if name == "amp"
        return "&"
    if name == "lt"
        return "<"
    if name == "gt"
        return ">"
    if name == "quot"
        return DQ
    if name == "apos"
        return "'"
    if name == "nbsp"
        return " "
    if name.starts_with("#")
        digits := name[1:<#name]
        if dates.has_digits(digits, 1, 3)
            code := int(digits)
            if 32 <= code <= 126
                return mime.character(code)
    return none

string replace_references(string text)
    result := ""
    position := 0
    while position < int(#text)
        end := -1
        string | none replacement := none
        if text[position] == "&"
            end = headers.find_from(text, ";", position + 1)
            if end >= 0
                replacement = reference_value(text[position + 1:<end])
        match replacement
            string decoded
                result += decoded
                position = end + 1
            none
                result += text[position]
                position += 1
    return result

bool tag_character(string symbol)
    int code := symbol.codepoints()[0]
    return (65 <= code <= 90) or (97 <= code <= 122) or (48 <= code <= 57)

LogicalLine[] html_blocks(string content)
    LogicalLine[] blocks := []
    depth := 0
    text := ""
    hide := ""
    position := 0
    while position < int(#content)
        close := if content[position] == "<" then headers.find_from(content, ">", position + 1) else -1
        if close < 0
            if hide == ""
                text += content[position]
            position += 1
            continue
        inside := content[position + 1:<close]
        position = close + 1
        end_tag := inside.starts_with("/")
        if end_tag
            inside = inside[1:<#inside]
        name_end := 0
        while name_end < int(#inside) and tag_character(inside[name_end])
            name_end += 1
        name := headers.lowercase(inside[0:<name_end])
        if hide != ""
            if end_tag and name == hide
                hide = ""
        elif not end_tag and headers.one_of(name, ["head", "style", "script"])
            hide = name
        elif name == "br" or (name == "li" and not end_tag)
            blocks = blocks.append(LogicalLine(depth, text))
            text = if name == "li" then "* " else ""
        elif headers.one_of(name, ["p", "div", "ul", "ol", "table", "tr", "blockquote", "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "h5", "h6"])
            blocks = blocks.append(LogicalLine(depth, text)).append(LogicalLine(depth, ""))
            text = ""
            if name == "blockquote"
                depth = if end_tag then math.max(depth - 1, 0) else depth + 1
    return blocks.append(LogicalLine(depth, text))

string[] html_lines(string content)
    string[] lines := []
    for block := html_blocks(content)[]
        text := headers.collapse_whitespace(block.text.split(NL).join(" "))
        text = replace_references(text).trim()
        if text != ""
            lines = lines.concat(wrap(text, quote_prefix(block.depth)))
        elif #lines > 0 and lines[-1] != ""
            lines = lines.append("")
    while #lines > 0 and lines[-1] == ""
        lines = lines[0:<#lines - 1]
    return lines

class Display(string format, string[] lines)

Display display_lines(Entity entity)
    if entity.subtype == "html"
        return Display("html", html_lines(entity.content))
    if headers.lowercase(entity.parameter("format")) == "flowed"
        return Display("flowed", flowed_lines(entity.content, headers.lowercase(entity.parameter("delsp")) == "yes"))
    return Display("plain", if entity.content == "" then [] else entity.content.split(NL))

string sender_address(Message message)
    match message.sender
        addresses.Mailbox mailbox
            return mailbox.address
        none
            return "-"

string sender_notation(Message message)
    match message.sender
        addresses.Mailbox mailbox
            return if mailbox.name == "" then mailbox.address else "{mailbox.name} <{mailbox.address}>"
        none
            return "-"

class Walk(int container, string prefix, int depth)

void walk(threader.Forest forest, int node, string prefix, string stem, int depth, Walk[] &entries)
    entries = entries.append(Walk(node, prefix, depth))
    int[] children := forest.nodes[node].children
    for: position < int(#children)
        last := position + 1 == int(#children)
        child_prefix := stem + (if last then "`- " else "+- ")
        child_stem := stem + (if last then "   " else "|  ")
        walk(forest, children[position], child_prefix, child_stem, depth + 1, &entries)

string container_notation(threader.Container container, Message[] messages)
    if container.message >= 0
        message := messages[container.message]
        return "[{message.number}] {date_notation(message.timestamp)} {sender_address(message)} {subject_notation(message.subject)}"
    return if container.subject_container then "[subject] " + container.subject else "[missing] " + container.id

string[] thread_report(threader.Forest forest, int thread_number, int root_id, Message[] &messages)
    Walk[] entries := []
    walk(forest, root_id, "", "", 0, &entries)
    distinct<string> sender_addresses
    int[] times := []
    count := 0
    maximum_depth := 0
    for entry := entries[]
        maximum_depth = math.max(maximum_depth, entry.depth)
        int message_index := forest.nodes[entry.container].message
        if message_index < 0
            continue
        count += 1
        messages[message_index].thread = thread_number
        messages[message_index].depth = entry.depth
        int parent := forest.nodes[entry.container].parent
        messages[message_index].parent_message = if parent < 0 then -1 else forest.nodes[parent].message
        match messages[message_index].sender
            addresses.Mailbox mailbox
                .sender_addresses.add(mailbox.address)
            none
                void
        match messages[message_index].timestamp
            int seconds
                times = times.append(seconds)
            none
                void
    lines := ["thread {thread_number} messages {count} depth {maximum_depth} senders {sender_addresses.size()}"]
    if #times == 0
        lines = lines.append("span -")
    else
        lines = lines.append("span {dates.format_utc(times.min())} .. {dates.format_utc(times.max())}")
    lines = lines.append("subject " + subject_notation(forest.root_subject(root_id)))
    for entry := entries[]
        lines = lines.append(entry.prefix + container_notation(forest.nodes[entry.container], messages))
    return lines

void check_parent_dates(Message[] &messages)
    for: index < int(#messages)
        parent := messages[index].parent_message
        if parent < 0
            continue
        match messages[index].timestamp
            int child_time
                match messages[parent].timestamp
                    int parent_time
                        if child_time < parent_time
                            .messages[index].problem("dated before parent message {messages[parent].number}")
                    none
                        void
            none
                void

string[] message_report(Message message)
    parent := if message.parent_message < 0 then "-" else "{message.parent_message + 1}"
    lines := [
        "message {message.number}",
        "id " + (if message.id == "" then "-" else message.id),
        "date " + date_notation(message.timestamp),
        "from " + sender_notation(message),
        "to " + (if #message.to == 0 then "-" else message.to.join(", ")),
        "cc " + (if #message.cc == 0 then "-" else message.cc.join(", ")),
        "subject " + subject_notation(message.subject),
        "refs " + (if #message.references == 0 then "-" else message.references.join(" ")),
        "thread {message.thread} depth {message.depth} parent {parent}",
    ]
    for entity := message.entities[]
        line := "part {entity.number} {entity.main_type}/{entity.subtype}"
        if not entity.multipart
            line += " {#entity.content}"
            if entity.disposition != ""
                line += " " + entity.disposition
            if entity.filename != ""
                line += " {DQ}{entity.filename}{DQ}"
        lines = lines.append(line)
    return lines

string[] body_report(string request, map<string, int> known_ids, Message[] messages)
    lines := ["request " + request]
    message_index := -1
    match known_ids.get(request)
        int number
            message_index = number - 1
        none
            return lines.append("not found")
    message := messages[message_index]
    parts := collect_text_parts(message.entities, message.root, true)
    lines = lines.append("message {message.number} text parts {#parts}")
    for index := parts[]
        entity := message.entities[index]
        display := display_lines(entity)
        quoted := 0
        signature := 0
        for: position < int(#display.lines)
            line := mime.trim_trailing(display.lines[position])
            if line.starts_with(">")
                quoted += 1
            if line == "--"
                signature = int(#display.lines) - position - 1
        lines = lines.append("part {entity.number} {display.format} lines {#display.lines} quoted {quoted} signature {signature}")
        for line := display.lines[]
            stripped := mime.trim_trailing(line)
            lines = lines.append(if stripped == "" then "|" else "| " + stripped)
    return lines

class SenderStats(string address)
    count := 0
    threads := distinct<int>()
    has_date := false
    first_time := 0
    last_time := 0
    name := ""

    void .add(Message message)
        count += 1
        .threads.add(message.thread)
        match message.timestamp
            int seconds
                if not has_date
                    first_time = seconds
                    last_time = seconds
                    has_date = true
                else
                    first_time = math.min(first_time, seconds)
                    last_time = math.max(last_time, seconds)
            none
                void
        match message.sender
            addresses.Mailbox mailbox
                if mailbox.name != ""
                    name = mailbox.name
            none
                void

string csv_field(string text)
    return if text.contains(",") or text.contains(DQ) then DQ + text.split(DQ).join(DQ + DQ) + DQ else text

string[] senders_report(Message[] messages)
    map<string, SenderStats> table
    for message := messages[]
        address := sender_address(message)
        if address == "-"
            continue
        entry := SenderStats(address)
        match table.get(address)
            SenderStats found
                entry = found
            none
                void
        .entry.add(message)
        .table.set(address, entry)
    SenderStats[] rows := []
    for address := table.keys().sorted()[]
        match table.get(address)
            SenderStats entry
                rows = rows.append(entry)
            none
                void
    stride := int(#rows) + 1
    int64[] order := []
    for: index < int(#rows)
        order = order.append(int64((int(#messages) - rows[index].count) * stride + index))
    lines := ["address,name,messages,threads,first,last"]
    for encoded := order.sorted()[]
        entry := rows[int(encoded) % stride]
        first := if entry.has_date then dates.format_utc(entry.first_time) else "-"
        last := if entry.has_date then dates.format_utc(entry.last_time) else "-"
        lines = lines.append("{entry.address},{csv_field(entry.name)},{entry.count},{entry.threads.size()},{first},{last}")
    return lines

string[] malformed_report(Message[] messages)
    malformed := [for message := messages[] if #message.problems > 0 then 1].sum()
    total := [for message := messages[] then int(#message.problems)].sum()
    lines := ["messages {#messages} malformed {malformed} problems {total}"]
    for message := messages[]
        for problem := message.problems[]
            lines = lines.append("message {message.number}: {problem}")
    return lines

string[] join_blocks(string[][] blocks)
    string[] lines := []
    for block := blocks[]
        if #lines > 0
            lines = lines.append("")
        lines = lines.concat(block)
    return lines

void write_output(string name, string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(lines.join(NL) + NL)

void thread_mailbox()
    Message[] messages := []
    map<string, int> known_ids
    for lines := read_mailbox()[]
        message := Message(int(#messages) + 1, lines, &known_ids)
        messages = messages.append(message)
    infos := [for message := messages[] then message.info()]
    forest := threader.Forest(infos)
    string[][] thread_blocks := []
    for: position < int(#forest.roots)
        thread_blocks = thread_blocks.append(thread_report(forest, position + 1, forest.roots[position], &messages))
    check_parent_dates(&messages)
    message_blocks := [for message := messages[] then message_report(message)]
    body_blocks := [for request := read_lines("input/requests.txt")[] then body_report(request, known_ids, messages)]
    bool directory_exists := file.is_directory("output")
    if not directory_exists
        file.mkdir("output")
    write_output("threads.txt", join_blocks(thread_blocks))
    write_output("messages.txt", join_blocks(message_blocks))
    write_output("bodies.txt", join_blocks(body_blocks))
    write_output("senders.csv", senders_report(messages))
    write_output("malformed.txt", malformed_report(messages))

if main
    thread_mailbox()

const base64_alphabet := "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"

string character(int code)
    byte := nat8(code)
    string result := string.from_utf8(bin(byte))
    return result

int hex_value(string text)
    int code := text.codepoints()[0]
    return if 48 <= code <= 57 then code - 48 elif 65 <= code <= 70 then code - 55 elif 97 <= code <= 102 then code - 87 else -1

string trim_trailing(string text)
    end := int(#text)
    while end > 0 and (text[end - 1] == " " or text[end - 1] == HT)
        end -= 1
    return text[0:<end]

nat8[] | none strict_base64(string text)
    if #text % 4 != 0
        return none
    end := int(#text)
    while end > 0 and text[end - 1] == "="
        end -= 1
    if int(#text) - end >= 3
        return none
    nat8[] result := []
    buffer := 0
    bits := 0
    for: position < end
        value := -1
        match base64_alphabet.find(text[position])
            nat found
                value = int(found)
            none
                return none
        buffer = buffer * 64 + value
        bits += 6
        if bits >= 8
            bits -= 8
            scale := 2 ^ bits
            result = result.append(nat8(buffer / scale))
            buffer %= scale
    return result

string | none decode_base64_body(string text)
    compact := text.split(" ").join("").split(HT).join("").split(NL).join("")
    nat8[] bytes := []
    match strict_base64(compact)
        nat8[] decoded
            bytes = decoded
        none
            return none
    nat8[] normalized := []
    position := 0
    while position < int(#bytes)
        if bytes[position] == 13 and position + 1 < int(#bytes) and bytes[position + 1] == 10
            normalized = normalized.append(10)
            position += 2
        else
            normalized = normalized.append(bytes[position])
            position += 1
    for code := normalized[]
        if code != 9 and code != 10 and not (32 <= code <= 126)
            return none
    string result := string.from_utf8(bin(normalized))
    return result

class Decoded(string text, bool failed)

Decoded decode_quoted_printable(string text)
    lines := text.split(NL)
    result := ""
    failed := false
    for: index < int(#lines)
        line := trim_trailing(lines[index])
        soft := line.ends_with("=")
        if soft
            line = line[0:<#line - 1]
        position := 0
        while position < int(#line)
            decoded := -1
            if line[position] == "=" and position + 2 < int(#line)
                high := hex_value(line[position + 1])
                low := hex_value(line[position + 2])
                if high >= 0 and low >= 0
                    code := 16 * high + low
                    if code == 9 or (32 <= code <= 126)
                        decoded = code
            if decoded >= 0
                result += character(decoded)
                position += 3
            else
                if line[position] == "="
                    failed = true
                result += line[position]
                position += 1
        if not soft and index + 1 < int(#lines)
            result += NL
    return Decoded(result, failed)

class MessageInfo(int number, bool dated, int seconds, string id, string[] references, string base_subject, bool reply)
class Container(string id)
    message := -1
    parent := -1
    int[] children := []
    subject := ""
    subject_container := false

bool key_less(MessageInfo first, MessageInfo second)
    if first.dated != second.dated
        return first.dated
    if first.dated and first.seconds != second.seconds
        return first.seconds < second.seconds
    if first.id != second.id
        ordered := [first.id, second.id].sorted()
        return ordered[0] == first.id
    return first.number < second.number

int[] postorder(int[] roots, Container[] nodes)
    stack := [for id := roots[::-1][] then 2 * id]
    int[] result := []
    while #stack != 0
        encoded := stack[-1]
        stack = stack[0:<#stack - 1]
        id := encoded / 2
        if encoded % 2 == 1
            result = result.append(id)
        else
            stack = stack.append(encoded + 1)
            for child := nodes[id].children[::-1][]
                stack = stack.append(2 * child)
    return result

int[] ranked_ids(int[] ids, int[] keys, int stride)
    int64[] encoded := [for id := ids[] then int64(keys[id] * stride + id)]
    return [for value := encoded.sorted()[] then int(value) % stride]

int[] group_of(map<string, int[]> groups, string subject)
    match groups.get(subject)
        int[] found
            return found
        none
            return []

class Forest(MessageInfo[] messages)
    Container[] nodes := []
    table := map<string, int>()
    int[] roots := []
    message_nodes := array(#messages, fill = -1)
    message_ranks := array(#messages, fill = 0)
    local int[] ordered := []
    for: index < int(#messages)
        position := int(#ordered)
        ordered = ordered.append(index)
        while position > 0
            if not key_less(messages[index], messages[ordered[position - 1]])
                break
            ordered[position] = ordered[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        ordered[position] = index
    for: index < int(#ordered)
        message_ranks[ordered[index]] = index
    for: index < int(#messages)
        .add_message(index)
    roots = [for id := (0:<int(#nodes))[] if nodes[id].parent < 0 then id]
    .prune_roots()
    .sort_all()
    .merge_subjects()
    .sort_all()

    int .container_of(string message_id)
        match table.get(message_id)
            int found
                return found
            none
                id := int(#nodes)
                nodes = nodes.append(Container(message_id))
                .table.set(message_id, id)
                return id

    bool ancestor_or_self(int ancestor, int other)
        current := other
        while current >= 0
            if current == ancestor
                return true
            current = nodes[current].parent
        return false

    void .adopt(int parent, int child)
        nodes[child].parent = parent
        nodes[parent].children = nodes[parent].children.append(child)

    void .add_message(int message_index)
        info := messages[message_index]
        container := -1
        if info.id == ""
            container = int(#nodes)
            nodes = nodes.append(Container(""))
        else
            container = .container_of(info.id)
        nodes[container].message = message_index
        message_nodes[message_index] = container
        int[] references := []
        for reference := info.references[]
            references = references.append(.container_of(reference))
        for: position < int(#references) - 1
            current := references[position]
            following := references[position + 1]
            if nodes[following].parent < 0 and not ancestor_or_self(following, current)
                .adopt(current, following)
        previous := nodes[container].parent
        if previous >= 0
            nodes[previous].children = [for child := nodes[previous].children[] if child != container then child]
            nodes[container].parent = -1
        if #references > 0 and not ancestor_or_self(container, references[-1])
            .adopt(references[-1], container)

    void .prune_roots()
        int[] empty := []
        int[][] replacements := array(#nodes, fill = empty)
        for id := postorder(roots, nodes)[]
            int[] children := []
            for child := nodes[id].children[]
                children = children.concat(replacements[child])
            nodes[id].children = children
            keep := nodes[id].message >= 0 or (nodes[id].parent < 0 and #children >= 2)
            parent := if keep then id else nodes[id].parent
            for child := children[]
                nodes[child].parent = parent
            replacements[id] = if keep then [id] else children
        int[] result := []
        for id := roots[]
            result = result.concat(replacements[id])
        roots = result

    void .sort_all()
        keys := array(#nodes, fill = 0)
        stride := int(#nodes) + 1
        for id := postorder(roots, nodes)[]
            if nodes[id].message >= 0
                keys[id] = message_ranks[nodes[id].message]
            else
                best := int(#messages)
                for child := nodes[id].children[]
                    if keys[child] < best
                        best = keys[child]
                keys[id] = best
            nodes[id].children = ranked_ids(nodes[id].children, keys, stride)
        roots = ranked_ids(roots, keys, stride)

    string root_subject(int root)
        if nodes[root].subject_container
            return nodes[root].subject
        message_index := nodes[root].message
        if message_index < 0
            message_index = nodes[nodes[root].children[0]].message
        return messages[message_index].base_subject

    void .merge_subjects()
        map<string, int[]> groups
        for root := roots[]
            string subject := root_subject(root)
            if subject != ""
                .groups.set(subject, group_of(groups, subject).append(root))
        int[] result := []
        for root := roots[]
            string subject := root_subject(root)
            if subject == "" or #group_of(groups, subject) == 1
                result = result.append(root)
        for subject := groups.keys().sorted()[]
            group := group_of(groups, subject)
            if #group < 2
                continue
            target := -1
            original := -1
            originals := 0
            for root := group[]
                message_index := nodes[root].message
                if message_index < 0 and target < 0
                    target = root
                if message_index >= 0 and not messages[message_index].reply
                    original = root
                    originals += 1
            if target < 0 and originals == 1
                target = original
            if target < 0
                target = int(#nodes)
                nodes = nodes.append(Container(""))
                nodes[target].subject = subject
                nodes[target].subject_container = true
            for root := group[]
                if root == target
                    continue
                if nodes[root].message >= 0
                    .adopt(target, root)
                else
                    for child := nodes[root].children[]
                        .adopt(target, child)
            nodes[target].parent = -1
            result = result.append(target)
        roots = result
